fusion_params.rank_reference: sorted training-fold scores per receptor; test scores are mapped through that frozen frame

bootstrap.paired_unit: greedy_vs_single on the same (target, fold, phi, k)
bootstrap.nested_lower_bound: 2.5% quantile of the cluster bootstrap of H_nested (selection fixed on A/B)

phi_selection.rule: inner-CV over 3 scaffold folds of the training fold; subset oracle on inner-train; utility on inner-held; ties keep the frozen fusion order

headroom_definitions.h_nested: mean over the A/B split of U_eval(S*_select) - U_eval(S_ref); selection on one half, evaluation on the other
headroom_definitions.h_perm: h_raw - q95(max_{S in TopM} U_test(S^perm)), 200 label permutations
headroom_definitions.reference: S_ref = better of {greedy, single} on the training fold, by the primary metric
headroom_definitions.oracle: exact enumeration of every subset of size k (no approximation)

inputs_sha256_note: D1 writes the authoritative hash manifest to results/headroom/<run_id>/input_manifest.json; this file stays frozen.
notes: E1 is an exploratory re-analysis of already-seen matrices (parent plan section 5.1).
Evaluation unit is the outer test fold as in scripts/nested_outer_k_evaluation.py (about 120 ligands per fold).
The four remote adaptive runs are read through their problem.json carriers; D1 re-verifies them and records the substitution.
